header.subtitle: Chronological archive of missions and roles.

udana.desc: Architecting and maintaining scalable full-stack applications using the TALL stack (Tailwind, Alpine, Laravel, Livewire) alongside Next.js and Inertia. I manage the entire deployment pipeline on AWS, optimizing server performance and ensuring high availability. My role involves building robust APIs, crafting seamless frontend experiences, and handling complex database migrations for SCF systems.

sfund.desc: Leading the frontend architecture for SFund's investment platform. I spearheaded the migration to Next.js App Router and TypeScript, significantly improving scalability and developer experience. My role involves bridging the gap between complex financial logic and user-friendly interfaces, integrating e-KYC and payment gateways, and mentoring the team on modern React patterns.

freelance.desc: Delivered diverse digital solutions ranging from immersive virtual tours for housing projects to comprehensive event management websites. I engineered custom WordPress themes for major exhibitions like IDEC and built specialized tools like RFID attendance systems, demonstrating adaptability across various tech stacks.

lokcay.desc: Pioneered the development of cross-platform VR applications using Ionic and Capacitor. I focused on creating seamless 360° virtual tour experiences that work flawlessly across web and mobile, optimizing performance and integrating native device features for a truly immersive user journey.

piranasia.desc: Managed the entire IT infrastructure, ensuring zero downtime for critical business operations. Beyond troubleshooting and network security, I streamlined data management with NAS configurations and developed internal documentation standards that improved team efficiency.
